assistant_dir.label: Assistant directory
assistant_dir.description: Dedicated chat context, separate from coding projects.

open_fullscreen.label: Open in full screen
open_fullscreen.description: Use full screen when opening from the bar or control center.

history_open.label: Show history on open
history_open.description: Expand the conversation sidebar when opening chat.

show_bar_status.label: Show status text in the bar
show_bar_status.description: Display working, waiting, and connection status beside the chat icon.

background_opacity.label: Chat background opacity (%)
background_opacity.description: 0 follows Noctalia’s panel background; 100 adds a solid background. Enable Noctalia panel transparency to see the desktop. Text stays opaque.

card_opacity.label: Chat cards opacity (%)
card_opacity.description: Scale the background opacity of message bubbles, composer, history, tools and approval cards. Text and controls stay opaque.

notify_completion.label: Notify when responses finish
notify_completion.description: Show a generic notification when a response finishes outside the visible chat.

notify_approvals.label: Notify when input is needed
notify_approvals.description: Notify about new approvals or questions outside the visible chat. Conversation content is not included.
